[P2] Recognize handlers passed to the wrapper by name

The parent-node check recognizes only inline handlers. In JavaScript, `const workflow = async (event, ctx) => ctx.map([1], async (child, item) => item); withDurableExecution(workflow);` produces no report: `ctx` is rejected as an unknown receiver even though its handler binding is available in the same file. This silently disables map/parallel checks for the separate-handler pattern. Resolve the wrapper's argument through its binding and record the handler function, then recognize its context parameter. Add coverage for named JavaScript handlers.
